```plato
//==
// # Matrices
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Matrices and tensors
//  - Sparse and banded matrices

//==
// # Matrices and tensors
//
// Dense numeric matrices (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Matrix_(mathematics))
// stored as row vectors: RowN holds row N, so element (r, c) is component c of
// row r. Fixed sizes cover graphics and geometry; MatrixN and Tensor cover
// scientific computing. The IMatrix interface they implement is declared in
// `matrices.concepts.plato`.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Matrices (System.Numerics-compatible row-vector
// multiplication, v' = v M).
// Discoverability: the concrete operations for the fixed-size
// matrices (Determinant, Invert, Multiply, Transform, Lerp, ...) are declared on
// the intrinsic hub in `intrinsics.library.plato`, not restated here;
// interface-generic helpers (Trace, FrobeniusNorm, IsSquare, ...) live in
// `numeric-structures.library.plato`.

// A 2x2 matrix: 2D linear maps (rotation, scale, shear).
type Matrix2x2
    implements IMatrix, IMultiplicative
{
    Row1: Number2;
    Row2: Number2;
}
```
